    10	/-!
    11	# Theta modules on affine-cover overlaps are base changes
    12	
    13	The intrinsic theta sheaf restricts from every widened affine piece to each pairwise
    14	overlap by base change. Passing through the equation quotients therefore identifies the
    15	piece theta quotient after extension to the overlap colength algebra with the overlap
    16	theta quotient itself. No extra certificate or geometric hypothesis is introduced.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    21	
    22	universe u
    23	
    24	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
    25	open scoped TensorProduct
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    32	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    33	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    35	
    36	namespace AffAdaptation
    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] thetaPieceSectionsModule thetaOverlapSectionsModule
    39	  thetaPieceQuotientModule thetaOverlapQuotientModule
    40	
    41	@[reducible]
    42	noncomputable def pieceSectionsToOverlapAlgebra (i j : D.index) :
    43	    Algebra Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
    44	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
    45	  (relResAlgHom C R
    46	    (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    47	
    48	attribute [local instance] pieceSectionsToOverlapAlgebra
    49	
    50	@[reducible]
    51	noncomputable def thetaOverlapSectionsLeftModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    52	    (i j : D.index) : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
    53	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
    54	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    55	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
    56	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsModule (π := π) a i j
    57	  Module.compHom (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j)
    58	    (relResAlgHom C R
    59	      (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i)).toRingHom
    60	
    61	attribute [local instance] thetaOverlapSectionsLeftModule
    62	
    63	@[reducible]
    64	noncomputable def thetaOverlapSectionsLeftTower (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    65	    (i j : D.index) : IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
    66	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    67	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
    68	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
    69	
    70	attribute [local instance] thetaOverlapSectionsLeftTower
    71	
    72	noncomputable def thetaSectionsToOverlapLeftLinearRing (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    73	    (i j : D.index) : A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a i →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)]
    74	      A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j :=
    75	  { toFun := A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j
    76	    map_add' := (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j).map_add
    77	    map_smul' := (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j).map_smulₛₗ }
    78	
    79	/-- Restriction of intrinsic theta sections from the left piece to an overlap is a
    80	base change. -/
    81	theorem isBaseChange_thetaSectionsToOverlapLeftLinearRing
    82	    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (i j : D.index) :
    83	    IsBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    84	      (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeftLinearRing (π := π) a i j) := by
    85	  let MV := A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a i
    86	  let MW := A.thetaOverlapSectionsModel (π := π) a i j
    87	  let F := thetaChartDatum C R π a
    88	  letI := MV.qcoh
    89	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
    90	      (F.sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces i))) :=
    91	    Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := F.sheaf) (le_refl (D.pieces i))
    92	  letI := MW.qcoh
    93	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    94	      (F.sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))) :=
    95	    Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := F.sheaf)
    96	      (le_refl (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
    97	  letI : Algebra Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
    98	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
    99	    ((relCurve C R).resHom
   100	      (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i)).toAlgebra
   101	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
   102	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   103	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsLeftModule (π := π) a i j
   104	  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
   105	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   106	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   107	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsLeftTower (π := π) a i j
   108	  have hbij := F.affineSectionsBaseChange_bijective
   109	    (D.isAffineOpen i) (D.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper i j)
   110	    (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) MV MW
   111	  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
   112	    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective
   113	      (F.affineSectionsBaseChange
   114	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) MV MW) hbij)
   115	  intro x
   116	  change F.affineSectionsBaseChange
   117	      (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i) MV MW
   118	        (1 ⊗ₜ x) = A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j x
   119	  rw [F.affineSectionsBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]
   120	  rfl
   121	
   122	noncomputable def thetaPieceQuotientMkLinear (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   123	    (i : D.index) : A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a i →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)]
   124	      A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i :=
   125	  (A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a i).mkQ
   126	
   127	noncomputable def thetaOverlapQuotientMkLinear (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   128	    (i j : D.index) : A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j
   129	      →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)]
   130	        A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j :=
   131	  (A.thetaOverlapVanishing (π := π) a i j).mkQ
   132	
   133	omit [IsProper C.hom] in
   134	theorem isBaseChange_thetaPieceQuotientMkLinear (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   135	    (i : D.index) : IsBaseChange (A.colength i)
   136	      (A.thetaPieceQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i) := by
   137	  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
   138	    (A.thetaPieceRestrictionEquivColength (π := π) a i)
   139	  intro x
   140	  change TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul
   141	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a i) (Ideal.span {A.eqn i})
   142	      (1 ⊗ₜ x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk x
   143	  exact TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul _ x
   144	
   145	theorem isBaseChange_thetaOverlapQuotientMkLinear (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   146	    (i j : D.index) : IsBaseChange (A.ovlColength i j)
   147	      (A.thetaOverlapQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i j) := by
   148	  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
   149	    (A.thetaOverlapRestrictionEquivColength (π := π) a i j)
   150	  intro x
   151	  change TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul
   152	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) (A.ovlIdeal i j)
   153	      (1 ⊗ₜ x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk x
   154	  exact TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul _ x
   155	
   156	@[reducible]
   157	noncomputable def pieceToOverlapLeftAlgebra (A : AffAdaptation D d) (i j : D.index) :
   158	    Algebra (A.colength i) (A.ovlColength i j) :=
   159	  (A.toOvlLeft i j).toRingHom.toAlgebra

   161	attribute [local instance] pieceToOverlapLeftAlgebra
   162	
   163	@[reducible]
   164	noncomputable def pieceSectionsColengthOverlapTower (A : AffAdaptation D d)
   165	    (i j : D.index) : IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
   166	      (A.colength i) (A.ovlColength i j) :=
   167	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

   169	attribute [local instance] pieceSectionsColengthOverlapTower

   171	/-- The overlap quotient, restricted to the left piece colength algebra. -/
   172	@[reducible]
   173	noncomputable def thetaOverlapQuotientLeftModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   174	    (i j : D.index) :
   175	    Module (A.colength i) (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j) :=
   176	  letI : Module (A.ovlColength i j) (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j) :=
   177	    A.thetaOverlapQuotientModule (π := π) a i j
   178	  Module.compHom (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j)
   179	    (A.toOvlLeft i j).toRingHom

   181	attribute [local instance] thetaOverlapQuotientLeftModule
   182	
   183	@[reducible]
   184	noncomputable def thetaOverlapQuotientLeftTower (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   185	    (i j : D.index) : IsScalarTower (A.colength i) (A.ovlColength i j)
   186	      (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j) :=
   187	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl

   189	attribute [local instance] thetaOverlapQuotientLeftTower

   191	@[reducible]
   192	noncomputable def pieceSectionsColengthThetaOverlapTower
   193	    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (i j : D.index) :
   194	    IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i) (A.colength i)
   195	      (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j) :=
   196	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl

   198	attribute [local instance] pieceSectionsColengthThetaOverlapTower
   199	
   200	@[reducible]
   201	noncomputable def thetaPieceToOverlapCompatibleSMul (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   202	    (i j : D.index) : LinearMap.CompatibleSMul
   203	      (A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i)
   204	      (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j)
   205	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i) (A.colength i) where
   206	  map_smul f r x := by
   207	    change f (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) r • x) =
   208	      A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) r) • f x
   209	    exact f.map_smul _ x
   210	
   211	attribute [local instance] thetaPieceToOverlapCompatibleSMul
   212	
   213	noncomputable def thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   214	    (i j : D.index) :
   215	    A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i →ₗ[A.colength i]
   216	      A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j :=
   217	  { toFun := A.thetaToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j
   218	    map_add' := (A.thetaToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j).map_add
   219	    map_smul' := A.thetaToOverlapLeft_smul (π := π) a i j }
   220	
   221	/-- Once arbitrary-affine restriction of the theta sheaf is known to be a base change,
   222	the induced divisor-quotient restriction is a base change as well. -/
   223	theorem isBaseChange_thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength
   224	    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (i j : D.index) :
   225	    IsBaseChange (A.ovlColength i j)
   226	      (A.thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength (π := π) a i j) := by
   227	  have hcomp : IsBaseChange (A.ovlColength i j)
   228	      (((A.thetaOverlapQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i j).restrictScalars
   229	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)).comp
   230	        (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeftLinearRing (π := π) a i j)) :=
   231	    IsBaseChange.comp
   232	      (A.isBaseChange_thetaSectionsToOverlapLeftLinearRing (π := π) a i j)
   233	      (A.isBaseChange_thetaOverlapQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i j)
   234	  have heq :
   235	      ((A.thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength (π := π) a i j).restrictScalars
   236	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)).comp
   237	        (A.thetaPieceQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i) =
   238	      ((A.thetaOverlapQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i j).restrictScalars
   239	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)).comp
   240	        (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeftLinearRing (π := π) a i j) := by
   241	    apply LinearMap.ext
   242	    intro x
   243	    rfl
   244	  rw [← heq] at hcomp
   245	  exact IsBaseChange.of_comp
   246	    (A.isBaseChange_thetaPieceQuotientMkLinear (π := π) a i) hcomp
   247	
   248	/-- The desired pairwise theta-module base-change equivalence. -/
   249	noncomputable def thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapLeftEquiv
   250	    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (i j : D.index) :
   251	    A.ovlColength i j ⊗[A.colength i] A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i
   252	      ≃ₗ[A.ovlColength i j] A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j :=
   253	  (A.isBaseChange_thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength (π := π) a i j).equiv
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	theorem thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapLeftEquiv_tmul
   257	    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (i j : D.index)
   258	    (c : A.ovlColength i j) (x : A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i) :
   259	    A.thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapLeftEquiv (π := π) a i j (c ⊗ₜ x) =
   260	      c • A.thetaToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j x :=
   261	  IsBaseChange.equiv_tmul _ c x
   262	
   263	/-- The canonical left map after base change to the pair overlap algebra. -/
   264	noncomputable def thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapLeft (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   265	    (i j : D.index) :
   266	    A.ovlColength i j ⊗[A.colength i] A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i →ₗ[A.ovlColength i j]
   267	      A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j :=
   268	  LinearMap.liftBaseChange (A.ovlColength i j)
   269	    (A.thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength (π := π) a i j)
   270	
   271	@[simp]
   272	lemma thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapLeft_tmul (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   273	    (i j : D.index) (c : A.ovlColength i j)
   274	    (x : A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i) :
   275	    A.thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j (c ⊗ₜ x) =
   276	      c • A.thetaToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j x := by
   277	  exact LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul
   278	    (A.ovlColength i j)
   279	    (A.thetaToOverlapLeftLinearColength (π := π) a i j) c x
   280

   312	noncomputable def thetaSectionsToOverlapRightLinearRing (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   313	    (i j : D.index) : A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)]
   314	      A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j :=
   315	  { toFun := A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j
   316	    map_add' := (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j).map_add
   317	    map_smul' := (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j).map_smulₛₗ }

   319	/-- Restriction of intrinsic theta sections from the right piece to an overlap is a
   320	base change. -/
   321	theorem isBaseChange_thetaSectionsToOverlapRightLinearRing
   322	    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (i j : D.index) :
   323	    IsBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   324	      (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRightLinearRing (π := π) a i j) := by
   325	  let MV := A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j
   326	  let MW := A.thetaOverlapSectionsModel (π := π) a i j
   327	  let F := thetaChartDatum C R π a
   328	  letI := MV.qcoh
   329	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   330	      (F.sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces j))) :=
   331	    Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := F.sheaf) (le_refl (D.pieces j))
   332	  letI := MW.qcoh
   333	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   334	      (F.sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))) :=
   335	    Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := F.sheaf)
   336	      (le_refl (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
   337	  letI : Algebra Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   338	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
   339	    ((relCurve C R).resHom
   340	      (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
   341	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   342	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   343	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsRightModule (π := π) a i j
   344	  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   345	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   346	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   347	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsRightTower (π := π) a i j
   348	  have hbij := F.affineSectionsBaseChange_bijective
   349	    (D.isAffineOpen j) (D.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper i j)
   350	    (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) MV MW
   351	  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
   352	    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective
   353	      (F.affineSectionsBaseChange
   354	        (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) MV MW) hbij)
   355	  intro x
   356	  change F.affineSectionsBaseChange
   357	      (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j) MV MW
   358	        (1 ⊗ₜ x) = A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j x
   359	  rw [F.affineSectionsBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]
   360	  rfl

   362	@[reducible]
   363	noncomputable def pieceToOverlapRightAlgebra (A : AffAdaptation D d) (i j : D.index) :
   364	    Algebra (A.colength j) (A.ovlColength i j) :=

   371	    (i j : D.index) : IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)

   377	/-- The overlap quotient, restricted to the right piece colength algebra. -/
   378	@[reducible]
   379	noncomputable def thetaOverlapQuotientRightModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   380	    (i j : D.index) :
   381	    Module (A.colength j) (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j) :=
   382	  letI : Module (A.ovlColength i j) (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j) :=
   383	    A.thetaOverlapQuotientModule (π := π) a i j
   384	  Module.compHom (A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j)
   385	    (A.toOvlRight i j).toRingHom

class CompatibleSMul [DistribMulAction R' N] : Prop where
  smul_tmul : ∀ (r : R') (m : M) (n : N), (r • m) ⊗ₜ n = m ⊗ₜ[R] (r • n)

/-- Note that this provides the default `CompatibleSMul R R M N` instance through
`IsScalarTower.left`. -/
instance (priority := 100) CompatibleSMul.isScalarTower [SMul R' R] [IsScalarTower R' R M]
    [DistribMulAction R' N] [IsScalarTower R' R N] : CompatibleSMul R R' M N :=
  ⟨fun r m n => by
    conv_lhs => rw [← one_smul R m]
    conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul R n]
    rw [← smul_assoc, ← smul_assoc]
    exact Quotient.sound' <| AddConGen.Rel.of _ _ <| Eqv.of_smul _ _ _⟩

/-- `smul` can be moved from one side of the product to the other . -/
theorem smul_tmul [DistribMulAction R' N] [CompatibleSMul R R' M N] (r : R') (m : M) (n : N) :
    (r • m) ⊗ₜ n = m ⊗ₜ[R] (r • n) :=
  CompatibleSMul.smul_tmul _ _ _

lemma SMulCommClass.of_commMonoid
    (A B G : Type*) [CommMonoid G] [SMul A G] [SMul B G]
    [IsScalarTower A G G] [IsScalarTower B G G] :
    SMulCommClass A B G where
  smul_comm r s x := by
    rw [← one_smul G (s • x), ← smul_assoc, ← one_smul G x, ← smul_assoc s 1 x,
      smul_comm, smul_assoc, one_smul, smul_assoc, one_smul]

lemma IsScalarTower.of_commMonoid (R₁ R : Type*)
    [Monoid R₁] [CommMonoid R] [MulAction R₁ R] [SMulCommClass R₁ R R] : IsScalarTower R₁ R R where
  smul_assoc x₁ y z := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_comm, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul]

lemma isScalarTower_iff_smulCommClass_of_commMonoid (R₁ R : Type*)
    [Monoid R₁] [CommMonoid R] [MulAction R₁ R] :
    SMulCommClass R₁ R R ↔ IsScalarTower R₁ R R :=

end

@[to_additive]
lemma smul_one_smul {M} (N) [Monoid N] [SMul M N] [MulAction N α] [SMul M α]
    [IsScalarTower M N α] (x : M) (y : α) : (x • (1 : N)) • y = x • y := by
  rw [smul_assoc, one_smul]

lemma smul_one_mul {M N} [MulOneClass N] [SMul M N] [IsScalarTower M N N] (x : M) (y : N) :

lemma mul_smul_one {M N} [MulOneClass N] [SMul M N] [SMulCommClass M N N] (x : M) (y : N) :
    y * x • (1 : N) = x • y := by rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_comm, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

lemma IsScalarTower.of_smul_one_mul {M N} [Monoid N] [SMul M N]
    (h : ∀ (x : M) (y : N), x • (1 : N) * y = x • y) : IsScalarTower M N N :=

    (H : ∀ (x : M) (y : N), y * x • (1 : N) = x • y) : SMulCommClass M N N :=
  ⟨fun x y z ↦ by rw [← H x z, smul_eq_mul, ← H, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]⟩

@[to_additive] lemma IsScalarTower.to₁₂₄ (M N P Q)
    [SMul M N] [SMul M P] [SMul M Q] [SMul N P] [SMul N Q] [Monoid P] [MulAction P Q]
    [IsScalarTower M N P] [IsScalarTower M P Q] [IsScalarTower N P Q] : IsScalarTower M N Q where

    [SMul M N] [SMul M P] [SMul M Q] [SMul P Q] [Monoid N] [MulAction N P] [MulAction N Q]

/-- Typeclass for multiplicative actions on multiplicative structures.

The key axiom here is `smul_mul : g • (x * y) = (g • x) * (g • y)`.
If `G` is a multiplicative group with automorphism group `Γ`, then there is a natural instance of
`MulDistribMulAction Γ G`.

The axiom is also satisfied by a Galois group $Gal(L/K)$ acting on the field `L`,
but here you can use the even stronger class `MulSemiringAction`, which captures
how the action plays with both multiplication and addition. -/

def piCongrLeft' (P : α → Sort*) (e : α ≃ β) : (∀ a, P a) ≃ ∀ b, P (e.symm b) where
  toFun f x := f (e.symm x)
  invFun f x := (e.symm_apply_apply x).ndrec (f (e x))

we have to explicitly substitute along `e.symm (e a) = a` in the statement of this lemma. -/

  { AddEquiv.piCongrRight fun j => (e j).toAddEquiv with

    invFun := fun f i => (e i).symm (f i)
    map_smul' := fun c f => by ext; simp }

  rfl

  rfl

    (piCongrRight e).trans (piCongrRight f) = piCongrRight fun i => (e i).trans (f i) :=

      A.ThetaOverlapProd (π := π) a := by

    (Equiv.prodComm D.index D.index).trans

    A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a q.2 q.1

    (hc : A.IsCertified n) :

      A.ThetaPieceProd (π := π) a ≃ₗ[A.chartProd]
      A.ThetaOverlapProd (π := π) a := by
  let e0 := A.chartProdTensorPiecePiEquiv (π := π) a
  let e2 := A.thetaPieceProdBaseChangeNestedEquiv (π := π) a hc
  let e3 := A.thetaOverlapProdSwapEquiv (π := π) a
  exact (e0.trans e2).trans e3

    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (x : A.chartProd)

    A.thetaPieceProdBaseChangeToOverlapEquiv (π := π) a hc (x ⊗ₜ s) p =
      A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (x p.1) •
        A.thetaToOverlapRight (π := π) a p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
  simp only [thetaPieceProdBaseChangeToOverlapEquiv,
    LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply,
    thetaOverlapProdSwapEquiv_apply,
    thetaPieceProdBaseChangeNestedEquiv, LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_apply,
    chartProdTensorPiecePiEquiv, TensorProduct.piRight_apply,
    TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul, pieceCoordinateDistrib_tmul_apply,
    thetaPieceBaseChangeToOverlapCoord_tmul]

noncomputable def thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange {n : ℕ}
    (_hc : A.IsCertified n) :

      A.ThetaPieceProd (π := π) a →ₗ[A.chartProd]
      A.ThetaOverlapProd (π := π) a :=
  LinearMap.liftBaseChange A.chartProd
    (A.thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightGlued (π := π) a)

theorem thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange_eq_comparison {n : ℕ}
    (hc : A.IsCertified n) :
    A.thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange (π := π) a hc =
      (A.thetaPieceProdBaseChangeToOverlapEquiv (π := π) a hc).toLinearMap := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul x s =>
      funext p
      rw [thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul]
      change (x • A.thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightGlued (π := π) a s) p =
        A.thetaPieceProdBaseChangeToOverlapEquiv (π := π) a hc
          (x ⊗ₜ[↥(gluedSubalgebra A)] s) p
      rw [thetaPieceProdBaseChangeToOverlapEquiv_tmul]
      change A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (x p.1) •
          A.thetaToOverlapRight (π := π) a p.1 p.2 (s p.2) = _
      rfl

theorem thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange_bijective {n : ℕ}
    (hc : A.IsCertified n) :
    Function.Bijective (A.thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange (π := π) a hc) := by
  rw [A.thetaIntrinsicDeltaRightBaseChange_eq_comparison (π := π) a hc]
  exact (A.thetaPieceProdBaseChangeToOverlapEquiv (π := π) a hc).bijective
